---
title: Template Gallery
description: The fifteen core designs that ship with Row-Template.
---

Row-Template ships **fifteen core templates**. Each is a complete design — its own
layout, its own typography, its own structure — and each is byte-locked, so a released
design cannot change without a deliberate, reviewed update.

Every template is available, every template is locked, and every template owns an
independent `layout.html`. There are no provisional designs.

## The catalogue

| Display name | ID | Design description | Category |
|---|---|---|---|
| Row | `row` | A single-column information system. Hierarchy from type scale and rules; almost no containers. The reference minimal design. | Minimal |
| Editorial | `editorial` | A modern technical publication: measured columns, a magazine rhythm, reading-first. | Editorial |
| Canvas | `canvas` | A calm, airy layout built on generous space and light separation. | Minimal |
| Prism | `prism` | A faceted information sheet: the record is cut into aligned facets. | Structured |
| Terminal | `terminal` | A text session sheet — monospaced, rule-divided, quietly technical. | Technical |
| Pulse | `pulse` | A signal-flow layout: the status reads as a live channel. | Dashboard |
| Brutal | `brutal` | A wide, high-contrast board with hard edges and no radius. | Bold |
| Arcade | `arcade` | A selection screen: strong primary choices, a game-like clarity. | Bold |
| Sketch | `sketch` | A hand-drawn sheet, ruled and informal. | Playful |
| Signature | `signature` | A premium service dossier: held by rules, measure and negative space. | Premium |
| Saffron | `saffron` | A narrow, warm, centred column. | Editorial |
| Pulse Nova | `pulsenova` | The Nova-era dashboard: cards, a rounded frame, a modern instrument panel. | Dashboard |
| Prism Nova | `prismnova` | The Nova-era console: dense, structured, information-forward. | Structured |
| Terminal Nova | `terminalnova` | The Nova-era console in monospace. | Technical |
| Arcade Nova | `arcadenova` | The Nova-era cabinet: a framed screen with a cartridge rail. | Bold |

Category names describe structure, not quality. **No template is ranked above another** —
they are different designs for different services.

## What every template shares

Whichever you choose, you get the same guarantees:

- **One self-contained artifact.** CSS, JavaScript, fonts and the QR generator are all
  inlined. The page fetches nothing from anywhere.
- **The same runtime.** Every template uses the shared runtime; a template is a layout and
  a stylesheet set, never a fork of the logic.
- **The same data.** Status, traffic, expiry, configurations and clients are identical
  across all fifteen.
- **Full right-to-left support.** Persian and Arabic are layout modes, not mirroring
  passes.

## What differs

Structure, typography, density and colour. The page tells the same story in fifteen
different voices.

## Screenshots

Each template will carry desktop and mobile previews in both themes. Those previews are
